title.zh: 体育馆「堕落」vs 小场「纯正」

summary.en: Both sides are half right. Volume is not a moral category.
summary.zh: 两边都只对一半。响度不是道德分类。

body.en:
Club kids call arena acts sellouts. Arena acts call club kids romantic about bad PAs. Punk arrives as a cut against stadium excess; Britpop and later indie reclaim big rooms under different clothes.

Useful test: do the songs still work when the room scales? Useless test: "real fans only saw them in a basement in 1992."
body.zh:
小场骂体育馆堕落。体育馆骂小场把烂 PA 浪漫化。朋克上来砍体育馆过度；Britpop 和后来的 indie 换一套衣服又把大场收回来。

有用标准：歌放大了还成不成？没用标准：「真粉丝只在 1992 年地下室见过他们」。

note.en: NYC clubs → festival headliners in one album cycle.
note.zh: 纽约小场 → 一张专的周期内冲到音乐节头条。
